newsitem.title: USA: Marlton obtains financing okay to buy DMS.
newsitem.headline: Marlton obtains financing okay to buy DMS.

text.p: Marlton Technologies Inc said Monday it has received a bank commitment to provide the required financing for its planned acquisition of privately-held DMS Store Fixtures.

The company also said that it has signed a definitive agreement to buy DMS for $14.5 million cash and up to 2.25 million unregistered shares of Marlton common stock. The terms of the deal, said the company, are in accordance with the letter of intent announced June 26.
The acquisition is still subject to additional conditions including approval by Marlton's shareholders.
DMS supplies custom made fixtures and displays to national retailers, department stores and consumer products manufacturers. In 1996 it had sales of approximately $30 million.
